cohort: 82 pregnant women with sickle cell disease (SCD) who tested positive for COVID-19
finding: COVID-19 infection in pregnant women with SCD had a typical presentation and rarely triggered a sickle cell crisis or other complications, and fetal outcomes were good.
mod_finding: The study found that one woman with sickle cell disease and COVID-19 required a cesarean section in the context of an ongoing vaso-occlusive crisis, acute chest syndrome, and incidental preeclampsia.
